question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to drink**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is butterflies.
 
• **Now, the butterflies will suck the juices of the flowers by using the proboscis.**
 
• **Thus, the correct phrase to use is "to drink."**
 
• **The verb 'to drink' means to consume liquid through the mouth**.(पीना)
 
 
• Example: I am going to drink a glass of water.
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as the other options are not related to consuming liquid.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, 'to gulp', means to swallow quickly and in large amounts.(गटकना)
 
• Option 2, 'to eat', means to consume food through the mouth.(को खाने के)
 
• Option 3, 'to gobble', means to eat something quickly and greedily.(हडप जाना)
